title: Evaluation of retrieval-based QA on QUEST-LOFT
authors: Nathan Scales; Nathanael Schärli; Olivier Bousquet
why_relevant: Analyzes RAG vs long-context performance on QUEST-LOFT with structured output and self-verification, touching on multi-document reasoning and verification, but not centrally about robustness, noise, conflict, or adversaries.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on improving accuracy on a complex multi-doc QA benchmark, not on unreliable evidence, calibration, or adversarial settings.
